opening.argument: The video is framed from the outset as a CID police-procedural episode: its title identifies “CID | CID | Episode 1023 | 29th March, 2021,” and the description expressly calls the series “hard-core police procedural stories dealing with investigation, detection, and suspense.” The mall shooting, suspects, weapons, undercover activity, surveillance footage, and evidence gathering are therefore elements of the depicted investigation, including the instruction to “get the footage from of all cameras in the mall” and “get all the evidence from around.” The monitor showing a mall corridor reinforces that dramatic setting. Finally, the end screen’s prompts to subscribe and keep watching are ordinary audience-engagement requests, with no stated financial participation or data collection.

citations.quote: The series consists of hard-core police procedural stories dealing with investigation, detection, and suspense.
Please do one thing, Sachin. You go and get the footage from of all cameras in the mall. Also, get all the evidence from around.
